simple.meaning: גּוֹרָל (gôwrâl) appears 77 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced as a daughter in the family line. The occurrence trail connects the name with an offering.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in Leviticus, Numbers, Joshua, Judges, 1 Chronicles, and 13 more, beginning at Leviticus 16:8. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as family, family line, offering, land, wilderness, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to גּוֹרָל (H1486) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: People in Scripture are understood by their place in the story. BibleIQ follows גּוֹרָל through the actual verses so the reader sees the person in context instead of as an isolated dictionary entry.
simple.summary: גּוֹרָל (gôwrâl) / H1486 is tracked through Leviticus 16:8, Leviticus 16:9, Leviticus 16:10, Numbers 26:55. The entry is generated from source alignment, occurrence evidence, and the surrounding Scripture context.

definitions.full: H1486. goral גּוֺרָל 77 noun masculine Lev 16:8 & ( Josh 21:10 , but see below) feminine lot : (Late Hebrew id. & denominative Hiph`il הִגְרִיל cast lots ) — absolute ׳ג 16:1 51t.; construct גּוֺרַל 18:11 2 t., גֹּרַל Num 36:3 ; suffix גּוֺרָלִי Psa 16:5 , גֹּרָלִי Judg 1:3 , גּוֺרָֽלְךָ Prov 1:14 , גֹּרָֽלְךָ Dan 12:13 , גּוֺרָלֶ֑ךָ Judg 1:3 , גּוֺרָלֵךְ Jer 13:25 ; Isa 57:6 , גּוֺרָלוֺ 1Chr 26:14 , גּוֺרָלָם Josh 18:11 2 t.; plural גּוֺרָלוֺת Jonah 1:7-8 t., גֹּרָלוֺת Lev 16:8 ; — a lot cast for the decision of questions Prov 18:18 , designation of persons, etc., for service or punishment, assignment of property, etc.; probably stones put into the bosom-fold of a garment, 16:33 ( אֶתהַֿגּ יוּטַל ׳בַּחֵיק ), or into a vessel, and shaken until one springs out ( יָצָא עָלָה, or — late — נָפַל ); this was regarded originally as divine decision (compare on Urim & Thummim p. 22, above); for the agent, the usual verbs are נָתַן יָרָה, הִשְׁלִיךְ, , and הִמִּיל . Particularly: — 1 lot for dividing land, especially that which Joshua cast at Shiloh י ׳לִפְנֵי Josh 18:6 ( יָרָה ) 18:8 ; 18:10 (both הִשְׁלִיךְ ; all three followed by לְ of person for whom; all J E); compare 19:51 (P); so of lot coming up, or forth, עָלָה 18:11 (construct; P), also followed by לְ person 19:10 (P), & following with יָצָא Joshua 16:11 (JE), Num 33:54 ; Josh 19:1 , 17 , 24 , 32 , 40 ; 21:4 (all P); be divided by lot בְּג ׳יֵחָלֵק Num 26:55 , or according to lot הַגּ ׳עַלמִּֿי תֵּחָלֵק 26:56 ; apportion by lot ׳בְּג הִתְנַחֲלוּ 33:54 ; 34:13 , בְּג ׳נִחַל Josh 19:51 ; give by lot בְּג ׳נָתַן Num 36:2 בַּגּ ׳נָתַן Josh 21:8 (all P) 1Chr 6:50 ; have by lot ל ׳הָיָה ׳בַּגּ Josh 21:4 , & ( היה omitted) 21:5 ; 21:6 (all P) compare 1Chr 6:46 ; 6:48 ; also Josh 21:10 (P; ׳הַגּ רִאישֹׁנָה , only here feminine; ᵐ5 — not ᵐ5 L — omits ראישׁנה , & so) || 1Chr 6:39 ; compare further Isa 34:17 ( לְ הִמִּיל ). 2 lot for assigning to service, duty or punishment, a. concerning the goats on day of atonement , Lev 16:8 ( עַל נָתַן ) 16:8 ; 16:8 (followed by לְ ); compare 16:9 ; 16:10 ( עַל עָלָה ; all P). b. assigning priests to their courses, singers, musicians & porters to their duties, by lot בְּג ׳חָלַק 1Chr 24:5 ; ג ׳הִמִּיל 24:31 ; 25:8 ; 26:13 (followed by לְ of position) 26:14 ; of lot coming forth ( לְ יָצָא person) 24:7 (compare 24:7 ; 24:18 ) 25:9 (compare 25:9-31 ) 26:14 compare גּוֺרָלוֺ וַיֵּצֵא 26:14 . c. cast lots for dwelling in Jerusalem ( ג ׳הִמִּיל ) Neh 1:11 (followed by infinitive) d. for supplying wood for altar-fire Neh 10:35 ( עַל הִמִּיל ); here belongs probably also e. Judg 20:9 בְּג ׳עָלֶיהָ , reference to 20:10 (determining who shall go up, and who supply provision) ᵐ5 ἀναβησόμεθα ἐπ’ αὐτὴν ἐν κλήρῳ , so Stu (insert perhaps נעלה ), compare AV RV, Bu RS 151 (who reads בְּג ׳נַמִּילָה ); > ᵑ6 Be Ke who reference ׳ג here to division of land of captured city. f. to determine guilty persons Jonah 1:7 (twice in verse) (both הִמִּיל ) 1:17 ( עַל נָפַל ); so apparently Ezek 24:6 of inhabitants of Jerusalem under figure of flesh in pot ג עָלֶיהָ ׳לֹאנָֿפַל no lot is fallen over it , i.e. no discrimination is made, destruction is to include the whole city; (compare also Josh 7:14 ff.; 1Sam 14:41 ff. where divine agency in detection is prominent but word גּוֺרָל not used). g. in allotting slaves Joel 4:3 גּ ׳יַדּוּ אֶלעַֿמִּי ; Nahum 3:10 ( עַל יַדּוּ ); so Obadiah 11 ג יַדּוּ ׳וְעַליְֿרוּשָׁלִַם — all with verb ידד q. v. h. in distributing plundered garments Psa 22:19 ( על הִמִּיל ). i. to determine favourable day for a scheme , הִמִּיל Est 3:7 ( הָמָן לִפְנֵי ) 9:24 (followed by infinitive; see also מּוּר ). 3 thing assigned, apportioned, allotted especially of land assigned by lot, allotment Josh 15:1 ; 17:1 ; 21:38 (all P), 17:14 , 17 = portion, share (|| נַחֲלָה J E); compare נַחֲלָתֵנוּ גֹּרַל Num 36:3 (P), נַחֲלָתָם גּוֺרַל Josh 14:2 (P; but perhaps read absolute גּוֺרָל compare Di); also גּוֺרָלָם גְּבוּל 18:11 (P) the boundary of their allotment ; גוֺרָלָם עָרֵי 21:20 (P); see further Judg 1:3 (twice in verse); so probably Micah 2:5 בְּג חֶבֶל ׳הִשְׁלִיךְ (Hi Che; compare also Ew); Psa 125:3 , land, exposed to oppressive exaction; also figurative of ׳י as portion, allotment of his people 16:5 (so Che, & on תָּמִיד for תּוֺמִיךְ compare his critical note; see also Ew; otherwise De and others; — || חֶלְקִי מְנָת ); on the other hand, of idols Isa 57:6 (|| חֵלֶק ); also לְג ׳עָמַד Dan 12:13 , of allotted portion, share , in the Messianic consummation; more Generally, one's portion, lot, fortune בְּתוֺכֵנוּ תַּמִּיל גּוֺרָֽלְךָ Prov 1:14 cast thy fortune into the midst of us, in with us (|| לְכֻלָּנוּ יִהְיֶה אֶחָד כִּיס ). 4 portion = recompence, retribution Isa 17:14 (|| חֵלֶק ), Jer 13:25 (|| מִדַּיִךְ מְנָת ), both implying divine agency.

In the day that you stood on the other side, in the day that strangers carried away his substance, and foreigners entered into his gates, and cast lots for Jerusalem, even you were like one of them.
They all said to each other, “Come! Let’s cast lots, that we may know who is responsible for this evil that is on us.” So they cast lots, and the lot fell on Jonah.

Yet was she carried away. She went into captivity. Her young children also were dashed in pieces at the head of all the streets, and they cast lots for her honorable men, and all her great men were bound in chains.
